name: Wiper Blades
summary: Front-only job (E90 sedan has no rear wiper). Replacement set PN 61612455435 is listed for 2010+ builds by BimmerWorld and Turner (supersedes 61612159627); pre-09/2009 cars use 61610427668. Driver blade 24 in is supported by two sources; passenger blade 19 in (youcanic) vs 18 in (autopadre) conflicts. Procedure is simple and consistent across sources; no tools or torque needed.
variantDependencies: Engine (N52B30 vs N51B30 SULEV) UNCONFIRMED: no evidence found that the brake/tire/wiper jobs differ by engine; not a tracked dependency but unverified.
RWD vs xDrive UNCONFIRMED: front wear sensor part number differs (34356789441 listed for xi/xDrive vs 34356789440 for non-xi); front jack point differs on xDrive.
Production date UNCONFIRMED: retailer fitment splits at 03/2010 (wear sensors) and 09/2009 (wipers); a 2010 model year car may fall on either side.
Brake package UNCONFIRMED: retailers split fitment between 'standard' and 'M Performance' front brakes (larger front brake); front pad part number depends on it.
Transmission (manual vs auto) UNCONFIRMED: no evidence it affects these jobs.

Build date: pre-09/2009 sets use 61610427668; 09/2009+ (2010+) sets use 61612455435 (supersedes 61612159627) per retailer listings. Passenger wiper ARM differs from 09/2009 (61619449924, Turner). BimmerWorld says 'not for 4-door models before 2010'.
Body style: sedan passenger blade 19 in (youcanic); coupe/convertible passenger 17 in; this is a sedan so sedan applies.
Drivetrain/engine: no evidence either affects wipers; unconfirmed.
Rear wiper: none on sedan (sedan has no rear wiper; one source lists none; not independently verified for this VIN).

tools.item: Towel or cardboard under arm to protect windshield

parts.item: Front wiper blade set (driver+passenger), 2010+ E90 incl. 328i/328i xDrive
Prior revision of that set (listed 2010-2011 by a Valeo retailer; Valeo mfr nos. 900-24-8B / 900-19-6B)
Pre-09/2009 E90 set (not for a 2010 build)
Another genuine E90 set listed without production date
Passenger wiper arm for builds from 09/2009 (only if arm is damaged)

torque.fastener: Wiper arm nut (not needed for blade swap)

steps.title: Park and prepare
steps.instruction: Park on level ground, ignition off. Fold a towel over the glass below the arm as a safeguard.
warnings: Dropped arm can crack the windshield.

steps.title: Lift arm
steps.instruction: Lift the wiper arm from the glass and hold it upright.
warnings: Hold the arm; do not let it snap back onto the glass.

steps.title: Release old blade
steps.instruction: Press the release tab and swing the blade perpendicular to the arm, then slide it off the hook/peg.
warnings: Exact E90 release tab design not shown in sources; one source describes a plastic cover on the hook.

steps.title: Fit new blade
steps.instruction: Slide the correct length blade on until it clicks. Driver 24 in, passenger 19 in (18 in per one source; verify against old blade).

steps.title: Lower arm and repeat
steps.instruction: Lower the arm gently and repeat on the other side.

steps.title: Test
steps.instruction: Run wipers with washer fluid to check for chatter, clean glass first if streaking.
warnings: Do not run wipers dry on dirty glass.

safety: Support the arm; a spring-loaded arm snapping back can crack the windshield.
Do not run wipers on dry glass.
missingEvidence: Passenger blade length: 19 in vs 18 in; only the Valeo mfr code 900-19-6B hints 19 in (inference, not stated).
